description: This file defines the AppConfig class for configuration settings in a Flutter application, providing environment-based URLs for API and WebSocket connections.

classes.name: AppConfig
classes.description: A configuration class that provides environment-based configuration URLs for API and WebSocket connections.

methods.name: apiBaseUrl
methods.description: A getter that retrieves the API base URL from environment variables, defaulting to 'http://localhost:8000' if not set.

methods.name: wsBaseUrl
methods.description: A getter that retrieves the WebSocket base URL from environment variables, defaulting to 'ws://localhost:8000/ws' if not set.
